'''2020 TMW Pods Gavin Ortlund DS Imperial Entanglements''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Gavin Ortlund]] at [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Pods).

* '''Player:''' [[Gavin Ortlund]]
* '''Event:''' [[2020 Texas Mini Worlds]]
